thread:
Marta: hey @here quick ping on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/62147 - eviction/ttl allocator change. need eyes from runtime, platform, and security before i can merge. goal: ship canary tonight 19:00 PT. TL;DR: change default KV eviction TTL from 12h -> 6h + guardrails for pinned keys. small perf impact but reduces mem pressure.

Kevin: @Marta I can take platform review. any perf numbers? will this affect shard rebalancer?

Marta: perf: ~2% p99 increase on short cache warmups but ~12% reduction in mem growth on stressed workloads. tested on staging with synthetic workload (perf log: https://perf.redwood.ai/compare/62147). rebalancer unaffected — TTL only affects eviction timelines. test plan and canary steps in PR description.

Samir: @Marta runtime note — i want to look at the LRU edge-case where kv.touch might race with eviction during decode. can you add a small unit/integration test for concurrent touch->evict? also pinging @orch-bot to rerun the evict integration.

Marta: added `tests/kv/test_ttl_eviction.py::test_concurrent_touch_eviction` to the branch and a short reproducer in `infra/testdata/kv-warmup.json`. local run: `pytest -q tests/kv/test_ttl_eviction.py` -> green.

Julia: @Marta security question — any KMS/auth changes here? does telemetry leak TTL values tied to tenant ids?

Marta: no KMS/auth changes. telemetry emits `kv.eviction.ttl_seconds` metric (aggregated histogram, no tenant ids). updated allowed-metrics.md and linked in PR.

security-bot: Security checklist:
- threat model updated: yes
- no secret or auth config changes: yes
- metrics reviewed: yes
See https://go/redwood/security/metrics/allowed-metrics for details. :white_check_mark:

orch-bot: CI status: `unit` ✅, `integration/eviction-smoke` flaky (1 failed). suggestion: `/retest integration evict-smoke` or rerun whole integration suite.

Kevin: i'll be merge steward for the canary tonight. propose canary window 19:00-20:00 PT. can we gate on: CI green + synthetic perf within 3% of staging baseline? @Samir can you own rollback?

Samir: yep i'll own rollback. rollback plan posted in PR (revert + drain new instances). triggers: >5% error rate or >20% p99 latency regression. i'll be on call and can flip route if we see issues.

Marta: thanks — assigning owners: platform: Kevin, runtime: Samir, security: Julia. i'll rerun failing integration and merge after green at ~18:50 PT if all good. /cc @oncall
